dialogArray: what type of room are you in?
Bottom of stair, black stairs black door. Yellow walls in stairway and some black/white painting on the wall at foot of stairs.
do you know what floor?

Hi. Where are you?
Hi, the spa room with two tables and white round tub here.
I see the room. Where in the room are you?
I am between the tub and spa table, looks so relaxing in here, thanks.
Where are you?
Ok let me move around, dining table with 6 chairs and white sofa on orange tile. Table looks green.

White chairs around table, then sofa and some other chairs in living area next me and small glass table on the back of the sofa. I am behind the sofa between table and sofa.

I am standing in front of a door to the outside. There is an empty kitchen next to me.
Are the counters white?
The cabinets are white, but the counters are black.
Do you see any table or anything else? The only kitchen I see has a white counter top.
No table, but I see some steps to go upstairs nearby. This kitchen only has a refrigerator and microwave in it. There is an empty space between counters where the stove would go.
What is the color of the floor?
It is dark wood. I am standing right in front of the door that leads outside.
Hey. Where are you?
Ok,  bottom of stairs by little red chair next to stairs. White tile floor, green plant here as well.
Anything else stand out?
Close the the gym.
Hello. What do you see around you? 4 floors, so if any colors stand out please let me know.

I am on the ground floor, I can see trees and grass outside opposite some sidewalk. I am in a living room, there is a large black couch on one wall, a gray chair in the corner, then another gray couch on the other wall. There are black and white pillows on all 3 objects and a triangle.
Okay. I am looking now.
Meant triangular coffee table in the middle and a small white table in front of the black couch. Floor is gray carpet. White table against the wall across from the couches.

No. There is also a clear desk near the door to the outside and a white and black geometric rug in front of the doors to outside. There are stairs outside the hallway near this room.
I got you. Where are you standing?
Near the black and white rug by the door.
Hi, what can you see around you?
There is a very long dining table with  lots of chairs around it. There is also a shorter table with a couple candles on it against the window and a buffet table on the other wall.

I am standing by the chair closest to the wall.

purple carpet. I'm standing near the red sofa and round seat in front of it.
